message.content: In the District 4 City Council Member race in Berkeley, Majdi "Gaith" Abuhamdieh recorded a September 25, 2026, statement that he has not taken and will not take AIPAC-aligned money, explicitly rejecting pro-Israel lobbying funds for his campaign. He holds a general-election endorsement from CAIR Action, a general-election supported designation with an Ally rating from Vote for Peace, a general-election endorsement from AROC Action, and a general-election supported designation from BAMC Action, whose recorded comment calls him "the only business friendly candidate that can turn around Berkeley." His organization funding record covers 2024 onward, with unresolved or mixed totals omitted rather than treated as proof of zero funding. The other candidate with a documented record, Igor A. Tregub, says he voted for a Berkeley peace resolution developed with Jewish Coalition of Berkeley guidance and stands by that vote. Tregub holds a general-election endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive, and secure Jewish state.
